CONTOUR_DISTINCTION.why_this_section_exists: An upgrade to a provenance classification is worth nothing if it blurs WHICH contour did the observing. The distinction is stated explicitly so no later reader can read this as a stronger local claim than it is.

local_execution_contour.why: No mail connector is authenticated in the local execution contour. The session is non-interactive and cannot complete an OAuth flow.
local_execution_contour.explicitly_not_claimed: This record does NOT claim that the local execution contour authenticated Gmail, read the message, or measured its identifiers. It did not.

CONTOUR_DISTINCTION.net_effect: The message identity and its substance are independently observed evidence in the Founder contour, and remain unmeasured in the local execution contour. That is an accurate strengthening, not a promotion to local measurement.

what_the_upgrade_does_not_extend_to.statement: This upgrade covers EXACTLY ONE provenance boundary: the fairness review message. No other record's classification is changed, and none may be inferred to have changed.
what_the_upgrade_does_not_extend_to.why_they_are_untouched: They concern different messages, which were not read in any contour under this order. Upgrading them by association would be exactly the fabrication this discipline exists to prevent.

independently_observed_substance.recorded_as: the substance of the message as independently read in the Founder contour

precisions_bound.subject: H-03 IV semantics
precisions_bound.content: An EMILIA role label alone does not establish independent verification. WEXP may derive IV from its frozen four-part predicate where that predicate is satisfied. That IV is a WEXP conclusion and does NOT establish independent verification of EMILIA semantics.
precisions_bound.effect: H-03 resolved by SCOPE SEPARATION. No frozen artifact altered.

precisions_bound.subject: native output support
precisions_bound.content: The INTEROP-001 P and P-1 native outputs support C-00 and H-01-a ONLY because the corresponding inputs are byte-identical. No native EMILIA output is established for H-01-b, H-01-c, H-02, H-03 or B-01.

precisions_bound.subject: verifier availability
precisions_bound.content: An available verifier implementation is NOT a frozen execution procedure.
precisions_bound.effect: The implementation is NOT run and results are NOT backfilled. Recorded as a standing prohibition.

precisions_bound.subject: scope of the comparison
precisions_bound.content: WEXP bridge sufficiency and joint WEXP x EMILIA comparison are different claims at different scopes and must not be collapsed.
precisions_bound.effect: Two explicit scoped verdicts replace the F-02 ambiguity.
